confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on a few undated travel blogs, a French and a German cost-of-living site, and Santiago-area menu prices, so they are rough. Wine has no direct price and is set from the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings, and assume July low-season winter pricing. FX comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the page directly, and the same results showed 0.6955 for 15 October, so the 16 October value should be verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Chilean Patagonian tourist-town pricing, cross-checked against Santiago menu and restaurant price levels. Local drink figures come from Puerto Natales bar and café price ranges in travel blogs. The peso-to-USD conversion assumes roughly 950 CLP per USD.
